contract: Coalesce edits to each editor visit using the trailing-task utility. After a 120 ms quiet interval, write only the latest text in that editing burst; later bursts must also save. Settle a visit’s pending accepted edit before close, replacement by open, submission, or disposal returns, so a later visit restores persisted text and submission retains its entry snapshot. Keep the public and injected interfaces synchronous, preserve supported queue and confirmation behavior, and leave the adjacent search preview outside this change. The reported defect is writing on every keystroke, not writing edits at all.

unknowns: The source does not explicitly prescribe a unique method for settling pending edits at boundaries.
The evidence does not establish a shared lazy cancellation mechanism.
